title: Safety corpus term (SAF phase 1, moderation pipeline spine, migration 0151)
description: One row of the compiled corpus. scope is 'global' (applies to every channel) or 'channel' (this channel's own addition) -- app_private.get_safety_corpus_terms returns both together, SAF-05's 'global plus per-creator' as one read. displayDecision/ttsDecision/moderatorReviewDecision are what this term forces on those surfaces when it matches (SAF-09); payment and the stored-record surface are never configurable per term.
